answer: Re-attestations are stored in gale and glacier lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 6 epochs, so holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the onyx graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 341 impostors cost 1696 times the honest price and take 10 times as long to clear. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
